Cosmetic log noise only; taps still work. Same finding as iter296. Reference: leaking through one of the RN wrappers on the root layout / journeys screen.

action_items: (Nice-to-have, carried over from iter296) Silence RN responder-prop console warnings on mobile /journeys (onStartShouldSetResponder etc. leaking to DOM).

(Not blocking) For deterministic frontend testing of the Statement Decoder graphic click flow on web, seed at least one statement for cathy@example.com — /app/statements list is currently empty so the live donut/legend click was verified by code inspection only.
critical_code_review_comments: PageIntro (/app/frontend/src/components/PageIntro.jsx) has the eyebrow prop destructured but NEVER rendered — good, but consider removing the now-dead prop entirely to avoid dead-code confusion and to make the API honest.

index.css sect-* rules use `!important` and a broad :is() selector that whites-out EVERY nested text element without a bg-* class. Verified on Handover Pack — labels, list items and paragraphs are all rgb(255,255,255). Ok, but any future nested muted/secondary text inside a sect-* panel will need an explicit bg-* class or its own override.

StatementInsightGraphics: donut and legend rows use real <button type=button> with onClick — accessible, focus-ringed, tabbable, correct data-testids (statement-money-graphic, money-graphic-donut, money-graphic-gov, money-graphic-you, statement-severity-graphic, severity-graphic-donut, severity-graphic-*). Scroll targets fall back gracefully across three selectors each.

Pricing.jsx: 'Recommended' badge positioned with negative top offset so it sits ABOVE the tier-family card (measured badge.top=349.78 vs family.top=360.78) — no clipping in light OR dark mode. Featured price colour computed to rgb(255,255,255) at 36px inside the teal gradient card — legible.
About.jsx renders about-cluster-card with rgb(251,252,254) background — white/cream, no heavy full-colour panel. Matches spec.
Contact.jsx submit flow works end-to-end: contact-form -> contact-submit -> contact-success renders. contact-info-cards renders.

Journey.jsx has journey-progress + journey-step-list + coloured hero band; journey-benefits is inside journey-persona (only shown when user is NOT onboarded), so Cathy (already onboarded) sees the reduced layout without the persona strip — expected.

Mobile DecoderResultView.tsx: decoder-summary-banner backgroundColor=colors.primary; header line color 'rgba(255,255,255,0.85)'; stream-card uses STREAM_TONES=['#0E4D52','#A5512B',...] with white 'rgba(255,255,255,0.75)' labels; who-paid stacked bar + severity-group-toggle-* Pressables + anomaly-card-* Cards are all interactive. All required testIDs present.
Mobile /journeys renders gradient linear-gradient(114.52deg,#0E4D52,#10363A) + journeys-progress + all 4 journey-step-{csc,ce2,budget,cpr} + 3 journey-more-* tiles.
Backend access_state contract (_compute_access_state) is stable — three canonical fixtures now resolve to the expected states.
